column4: https://es.wiktionary.org/wiki/encanar : lunfardo slang from cana (jail) = put in jail
morphology: from canuto (tube) = roll up into a tube
https://dle.rae.es/engarabitar : primary sense poner los dedos entumecidos por el frio en forma de garabato (curl numb fingers); trepar/climb is secondary
morphology: inchoative -ecer on mudo (mute); primary intransitive = fall silent
https://www.rae.es/dpd/ennoviar : entablar relacion de noviazgo / hacerse novio de alguien (become boy/girlfriend) not formal engagement
morphology: chess term from roque/torre = castle
morphology: inchoative -ecer on ronco (hoarse) = make hoarse
https://www.rae.es/dpd/ensa%C3%B1ar : ensañarse = deleitarse en causar dano = be cruel (drop comma from current)
morphology: from señor = make oneself master / take over
morphology: inchoative -ecer on soberbio (arrogant) = make arrogant
https://dle.rae.es/entallar : primary sense ajustar la ropa al talle (fit garment); carve is secondary
morphology: from tela (cloth) = cover with cloth
